summary: macOS notarization rejection prevents driver profile application after corporate CA rotation
description:
Issue summary:
After yesterday's corporate CA rotation roll, several recently imaged macOS devices fail to install our vendor-signed kextless driver bundle during MDM profile application. The MDM (Workspace ONE/Intune hybrid) reports 'Notarization check failed' for the driver package and profile installation stalls in the post-imaging phase. This is affecting new hires and depot repairs finishing imaging in two regions.
impact: Newly provisioned macOS laptops are not completing post-imaging driver/profile steps. Impact scope: ~28 devices across two depots (US-W and EU-W). Affected devices are not fully operational for secure Wi-Fi and the VPN client, delaying device handoff to users.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Apply current corporate image (macOS 13.6 custom image) via depot autoprovisioning.
2) Let MDM enrollment complete and device receive 'Corp Driver' configuration profile.
3) Observe profile status in MDM console and installer logs.
4) Reproduce on an affected Mac: installer logs show notarization check retry and MDM marks as 'Failed - Notarization'.
logs:
Installer log snippet (device A):
- 2026-03-12T02:11:23Z MDMProfileManager: Received install payload 'Corp Driver Bundle'
- 2026-03-12T02:11:23Z PackageKit: Verifying code signature and notarization status
- 2026-03-12T02:11:24Z PackageKit: Notarization validation failed: com.apple.sec.notarization.error (status=402)
- 2026-03-12T02:11:24Z MDMClient: Installation result: kMDMStatusNotAuthorized (Notarization check failed)
Associated syslog entries show ocspd fetches to internal OCSP responder returning 500 for leaf cert chain.
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: CA rotation introduced a new leaf/issuing cert that is not yet resolvable/served correctly by our OCSP responder and local notarization servers.
- Verified package signatures are intact and vendor signatures unchanged.
- Replicated failure on a clean image in lab by binding to prod MDM and forcing profile push.
- Observed OCSP responder logs show a malformed request path from macOS clients after rotation; responder returning HTTP 500 for certain cert serial formats.
- Confirmed that devices which had previous cached OCSP responses (old chain) succeed; freshly imaged devices that follow the new chain fail.
- Cross-checked with Vendor: driver bundles were re-signed against new corp intermediate per rotation guidance. Vendor confirms signing process completed and notarization ticket available on Apple notarization service.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:34 - Priya Desai: Reported by Depot team after 12/28 devices failed to reach 'Provisioned' state. Created ticket and attached sample logs.
2026-03-11 11:02 - Marco Ruiz: Started triage. Reproduced in lab. Opening thread with infra (ocsp-team) and security (pkix) to look at responder behavior.

2026-03-11 13:47 - Lina Gomez (Infra): Observed 500s from ocsp01 redwood.internal between 02:10-02:20 UTC. Stack trace shows error parsing serial numbers with leading zeros for the new intermediate. Rolling a quick fix to normalize serial format on ocsp01-03.

2026-03-12 07:05 - Support (Marco): After ocsp normalization patch, one affected device progressed to 'Installing' but then stalled on notarization ticket fetch (Apple side). Reached out to Vendor for notarization ticket traceback.

2026-03-12 15:30 - Vendor (SecureDrivers Inc.): Confirmed re-submission to Apple notarization service succeeded for affected bundles; shared notarization UUIDs. Apple reports brief service delay during rotation window but no outstanding blocks.
2026-03-13 09:20 - Lina Gomez (Infra): Deployed additional logging and fixed a header mismatch in ocsp proxy. OCSP 200s observed for new chain on test devices. Need to validate at scale.
2026-03-13 12:05 - Marco Ruiz: Rolling limited re-provision in US-W depot for 5 devices to validate. Monitoring MDM and installer logs.
2026-03-13 16:48 - Priya Desai: Depot team confirmed 5 test devices completed provisioning successfully and VPN/Wi-Fi drivers installed. Expanding rollout.
resolution_notes:
Workaround: Reprovision affected devices after ocsp proxy normalization and after Vendor re-submitted notarization tickets. Permanent fix path: ocsp proxy code updated to accept leading-zero serial formats and normalize requests; added post-CA-rotation checklist item to run automated OCSP probe suite and validate notarization ticket retrieval from Apple before depot rollout.
Rollout plan:
- 2026-03-13: Apply ocsp proxy patch to prod ocsp01-ocsp03 (done).
- 2026-03-14: Run smoke reprovision of 10 devices per depot (US-W, EU-W).
- 2026-03-15: Full depot requeue of remaining failed devices; monitor for 24h.
Follow-ups:
- Add an automated check in the CA rotation SOP to validate MDM driver notarization end-to-end.
- Add vendor coordination step requiring notarization UUIDs and explicit Apple validation window before rotation cutover.
- File a postmortem if any devices still fail after full rollout.
next_steps: Complete depot requeue for remaining 23 devices and validate success metrics
Add ocsp probe to CA rotation pipeline (PR in mdm-ops)
